claims.text: CISA lists CVE-2026-83548 and CVE-2026-83549 as exploited in the wild.

3 independent sources report this event.

events.title: CVE-2026-48710: Kludex Starlette Kludex Starlette HTTP Request/Response Smuggling Vulnerability
events.summary: Kludex Starlette contains a HTTP request/response smuggling vulnerability that could allow attackers to inject paths into the host part, prepending the actual path leading to issues such as authentication bypass when the authentication depends on the reconstructed URL’s path. This vulnerability could be chaned with CVE-2026-42271.

claims.text: CISA lists CVE-2026-42271 and CVE-2026-48710 as exploited in the wild.
CVE-2026-42271 is rated 8.7 (high) under CVSS 4.0 by the CNA that assigned it, the highest of the 2 scored CVEs here.
FIRST's EPSS puts the chance of CVE-2026-42271 being exploited in the next 30 days at 93%, the highest of the 2 CVEs here.
A fix for starlette (PyPI) is published in 1.0.1, per GHSA-86qp-5c8j-p5mr.
A fix for litellm (PyPI) is published in 1.83.7, per GHSA-v4p8-mg3p-g94g.
